detail.longDescription: Lately I've been thinking about how AI agents are moving from using our systems to operating them, and how the next systems we build might have an AI as their main operator. This led me to experiment with my own setup: what changes when an agent gets a # kubernetes cluster of its own instead of a borrowed key to ours? I put some thoughts about it into a # blog : https:// cloudrumble.net/blog/ai-operat ors-platform-users/ or a # video if you prefer: https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=yWvU7jXGtPQ # ai # platformengineering # linux # foss
